description: B7's word and kill-outright on the retail D-gun, on Show Down. The D-gun deals 30 000; a commander's own level scales what it deals (0x499DB5), so a commander with 25 kills (stock level 5, 130 %) deals 39 000, past the HP word: stock wraps it to -26 536 and the metal storage it hits (1 329 HP) GAINS 26 536, where B7's saturation kills it. Select vet_com, press its D-GUN order and click the storage. The commanders stay (the player's energy pays for the shot).
